claims.statement: The ministry dates this period to approximately 2181 BCE–2055 BCE.
Provincial governors gained independence as central royal control weakened.

evidence.note: Approximate period boundaries follow the Egyptian ministry. Other entries use museum chronologies, so boundaries can overlap or leave small gaps; these are dating differences, not evidence that nothing happened.
